330:t_101:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「This guy's overfamiliarity rubs me the wrong way, just like $$ガウルン$$'s!」

330:t_102:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(This thing's performance is M9 class... It's a hollow shell, but it can hold its own well enough.)

330:t_102:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(But like it or not, it drives home that $$アル$$ is gone...)

330:t_102:2.en:
$$宗介$$
(...To repay the one who fought alongside me to the very end, I will do this...!)

330:t_103:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「I've been dying to see you, $$ロジャー・スミス$$! Seriously!」

330:t_103:1.en:
$$ダヴ$$
「Boss... he's so full of life...」

330:t_103:2.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「It's like his lack of motivation earlier was all a lie...」

330:t_103:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm honored... is what I'd like to say, but unfortunately I have no time to deal with thugs.」

330:t_103:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「I'll let that smart mouth slide, just for today! Though I'll shut you up soon enough!」

330:t_103:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...$$ベック$$. Could it be that you're dissatisfied with working as a subcontractor for $$アマルガム$$?」

330:t_103:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If you're willing to reform, we're not strangers... I'm willing to lend you a hand.」

330:t_103:8.en:
$$ベック$$
「Shut up! Beating the hell out of guys with that high-and-mighty attitude is a hobby of mine too!」

330:t_103:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「In that case, there are people in the world today who act far more high-and-mighty than I do. A bunch called the $$サイデリアル$$...!」

330:t_104:0.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Our opponent is that weirdo! I'll settle this with a lightning strike!」

330:t_104:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hm...? The Indecent Teacher and Pet Boy... has their relationship changed a little?」

330:t_104:4.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Wow, that's kinda naughty! The great $$ゲイツ$$ loves that stuff!」

330:t_104:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n! Wipe that guy out completely!! Don't leave a speck of dust!」

330:t_105:0.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$... So I get to fight alongside you again.」

330:t_105:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Let's do our best with $$宗介$$ again. To rescue $$千鳥$$, too.)
